Context7 supports the XDG Base Directory Specification. Update to a current version and it will migrate this directory's contents automatically:

- Credentials move to `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/context7/credentials.json`.
- CLI state moves to `$XDG_STATE_HOME/context7/cli-state.json`.
- Generated previews move to `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/context7/previews/`.

The default locations are `~/.config/context7/`, `~/.local/state/context7/`, and `~/.cache/context7/` respectively. See [Context7 issue #2638](https://github.com/upstash/context7/issues/2638) for details.
